{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display basic info
print(penguins.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:')
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of key variables
print('\nSummary statistics for flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g:')
print(penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].describe())"}
